zone_definitions.label: Follows Saudi Arabia
zone_definitions.description: Adopts Saudi Supreme Court announcements (often aligning with Umm al-Qura calendar).

zone_definitions.label: Follows Turkey / ECFR Global Calculation
zone_definitions.description: 2016 Istanbul Unified Calendar: moon altitude > 5° and elongation > 8° at local sunset anywhere on Earth.

zone_definitions.label: Local / Regional Physical Sighting
zone_definitions.description: Requires verified physical crescent sighting within national or shared regional horizon (e.g., South Africa UUCSA/COSSA, Morocco, Pakistan, India).

zone_definitions.label: National Criteria / Mixed Sub-Communities
zone_definitions.description: Uses custom astronomical rules (e.g., MABIMS 3°/6.4° in SE Asia, Egypt moonset >= 5m after sunset) or has split local/follower communities (UK, USA, Canada).
